acceptance: Red test first: route-lane --blocked-by X on item Y gives Y deps [X] and status waiting.
An unknown blocker id is refused with the id.
After X is consumed, Y is ready without a manual step.

consumed.resolution: evolve inbox route-console and route-lane take --blocked-by <item-id>; the blocker joins deps through inboxmover.Edit, so the lane menu wakes the item when the blocker is consumed.

fix: Add --blocked-by <item-id> to evolve inbox route-console and route-lane: it checks that the blocker item exists and adds it to deps. A blocked item routed to the lane stays Waiting until the blocker is consumed.
source: console, 2026-10-27, cycle resume investigation (scratchpad cycle-resume-research.md), operator question on resuming failed cycles
summary: Items parked for a blocker keep the blocker only as text with deps []. Nothing wakes them when the blocker lands (2041, 2045, 2046 in wave 143). The deps edge and the Waiting state already exist (dispatchability.go:25-69).
title: A held item names its blocker item as a deps edge, so it wakes when the blocker is consumed
